candidates.name: tx.origin authorization
candidates.description: Authorization based on tx.origin can be abused through a malicious intermediary contract.
candidates.root_cause: Authorization checks the transaction origin instead of the intended caller identity.
candidates.mitigation: Use an appropriate caller-based authorization design and test intermediary call paths.
candidates.severity_note: Illustrative test-data rating; actual severity depends on impact and context.

facts.text: An intermediary contract can call a target within a transaction initiated by a victim.
The transaction origin and the immediate caller can be different addresses.
Caller-based authorization should be evaluated on intermediary call paths, not only direct calls.
